speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Emergency funding for Hawaii has nothing to do with Ukraine. I'm against additional funding for Ukraine for a number of reasons. I don't think it's our national security issue. I don't think that we ought to be leading NATO in Europe and carrying the lion's share of it. I don't know what the exit strategy, I don't know what the result looks like. I don't know what the limit of U.S. involvement is. We don't have accountability for the $113 billion or so that's already been sent there. We have to borrow the money that we do send there. We've got our own national security issues. We've got our own weakened military issues. Why would we continue to exacerbate our own problems by sending resources to Ukraine?
